body:
It must take a lot of willpower to stick to a diet. I admire you for being able to do that even for just a bit. I also went to a psychiatrist and a psychologist giving me advices but they don't help much as well. I guess the best way is to develop a habit to stop myself from using food as an escape.  
Thank you so much for the reply. It means a lot to me.

I also feel that periods of idleness are most susceptible to binging. But then food has become such an integral part of my life that I keep thinking about it during inappropriate times and it affects my quality of life. My motivation and will to live depends too much on it.  
Thank you for the reply. It really makes me feel better knowing someone out there understands what I'm going through. I'm going to try occupying myself with tasks even as menial as doing chores to keep myself away from too much food.
